description: This file implements the JIT graph transformation pass for automatic mixed precision (autocast) in PyTorch, handling autocast node detection, parsing, tensor input casting, and managing autocast states within graph blocks.

classes.name: AutocastContext
classes.description: Holds autocast enable flags and scalar types for GPU and CPU.

classes.name: AutocastScope
classes.description: Represents an autocast node scope with associated context.

methods.name: isAutocastNode
methods.description: Checks if a Value corresponds to an autocast node based on module name.

methods.name: parseAutocast
methods.description: Parses a Value to determine if it represents an autocast scope, extracting enabled flags and device info.

methods.name: castTensorInputs
methods.description: Inserts cast operations into node inputs based on autocast context and cast type.

methods.name: hasExplicitDtypeArgument
methods.description: Checks if a node has an explicit dtype argument.

methods.name: castInputsToWidestType
methods.description: Casts node inputs to the widest type (e.g., float32) for promotion.

methods.name: updateAutocastEnabledCheck
methods.description: Replaces autocast enable check nodes with constant true values if autocast is enabled.

methods.name: handleBlock
methods.description: Recursively processes a graph block, managing autocast states and inserting cast operations.

methods.name: setAutocastMode
methods.description: Enables or disables autocast mode globally.

methods.name: Autocast
methods.description: Main function to apply autocast transformations to a graph.
